program:
PARAMS = {
    "W6":    (30.0, 12.0, 80.0),     # NMOS output device width [um] (mirror of MB0)
    "Ln6":   (0.15, 0.15, 0.3),      # L of MB0 / MT / MN6 (mirror group)
    "W7":    (70.0, 25.0, 180.0),    # PMOS output device width [um] (loop-controlled)
    "Lp7":   (0.15, 0.15, 0.3),      # L of MP7
    "Nout":  (6.3, 4.5, 6.8),        # output branch current / iref
    "Cc":    (1.5e-12, 0.5e-12, 3e-12),  # AC coupling caps fb->x and fb->gn
    "R1":    (20e3, 8e3, 45e3),      # series resistor from vin1
    "kgain": (0.1135, 0.108, 0.119), # Rf/R1
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    vdd = 1.8
    W6, L6, W7, L7 = p["W6"], p["Ln6"], p["W7"], p["Lp7"]
    wb = W6 / p["Nout"]            # MB0 width -> I6 = Nout*iref
    wt = 0.5 * wb                  # servo tail ~ iref/2
    R1 = p["R1"]; Rf = p["kgain"] * R1
    Cc = p["Cc"]
    RB = 2e6

    n = Netlist("vin1 vin2 vout vcm vdd vss ibias")
    # bias
    n.M("MB0", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", "nfet", wb, L6)
    n.M("MT", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", "nfet", wt, L6)
    # small DC-servo OTA (sets MP7 gate so vout tracks vcm)
    n.M("M1", "dg", "fb", "tail", "vss", "nfet", 3.0, 0.5)
    n.M("M2", "x", "vcm", "tail", "vss", "nfet", 3.0, 0.5)
    n.M("M3", "dg", "dg", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", 2.0, 0.5)
    n.M("M4", "x", "dg", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", 2.0, 0.5)
    # current-reuse output stage
    n.M("MP7", "vout", "x", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", W7, L7)
    n.M("MN6", "vout", "gn", "vss", "vss", "nfet", W6, L6)
    n.R("RB", "ibias", "gn", RB)           # DC bias of MN6 = mirror of MB0
    n.C("CN", "fb", "gn", Cc)              # AC drive of MN6
    n.C("CC", "fb", "x", Cc)               # AC feed-forward to MP7 gate
    # feedback network
    n.R("R1", "vin1", "fb", R1)
    n.R("RF", "fb", "vout", Rf)
    n.R("R2", "vin2", "vcm", 1e6)

    # ---- analytic model ----
    def solve(dv, W, L, Id, vds, vsb=0.0):
        lo, hi = 0.05, 1.6
        o = None
        for _ in range(40):
            mid = 0.5 * (lo + hi)
            o = lut.op(dv, W, L, mid, vds, vsb)
            if o["Id"] < Id:
                lo = mid
            else:
                hi = mid
        return o
    i6 = p["Nout"] * iref
    itail = 0.5 * iref
    o6 = solve("n", W6, L6, i6, 0.9)
    o7 = solve("p", W7, L7, i6, 0.9)
    o1 = solve("n", 3.0, 0.5, itail / 2, 0.5, 0.3)
    o4 = solve("p", 2.0, 0.5, itail / 2, 0.9)
    cl = 1.0e-12                            # load inferred from sim (~1 pF)
    gl = 1.0 / 16e3                         # inferred resistive load
    gm6, gm7 = o6["gm"], o7["gm"]
    go = gl + o6["gds"] + o7["gds"]
    a_hf = (gm6 + gm7) / (go + 1.0 / (R1 + Rf))
    cg6 = o6["cgg"] * 1.2 + 0.25e-15 * W6 * (1 + a_hf)
    cg7 = o7["cgg"] * 1.2 + 0.25e-15 * W7 * (1 + a_hf)
    cout = cl + 0.5e-15 * (W6 + W7) + 10e-15
    cfb_par = 30e-15
    gota = o1["gm"]
    rota = 1.0 / (o1["gds"] + o4["gds"] + 1e-12)

    def H(f):
        s = 2j * PI * f
        Yx = 1.0 / rota + s * (Cc + cg7)
        kx = (gota + s * Cc) / Yx
        Ygn = 1.0 / RB + s * (Cc + cg6)
        kn = (s * Cc) / Ygn
        Yfb_c = s * Cc * (1 - kx) + s * Cc * (1 - kn) + s * cfb_par
        gm_eff = gm6 * kn + gm7 * kx
        a11 = 1 / R1 + 1 / Rf + Yfb_c + 1e-12
        a12 = -1 / Rf
        a21 = gm_eff - 1 / Rf
        a22 = go + 1 / Rf + s * cout
        det = a11 * a22 - a12 * a21
        return (-a21 / det) / R1

    a1 = H(1.0).real
    npts = 700
    fs = [10.0 ** (3.0 + 7.0 * k / (npts - 1)) for k in range(npts)]
    mags = [abs(H(f)) for f in fs]
    ref = abs(a1) + 1e-30
    mmax = 0.0
    for m in mags:
        if m > mmax:
            mmax = m
    peak = mmax / ref
    bw = fs[-1]
    for k in range(npts):
        if mags[k] < 0.7071 * ref:
            bw = fs[k]
            break
    if peak > 1.41:
        bw = min(bw, 1e6)
    power = vdd * (iref + itail + i6)
    return n, {"a1": a1, "bw": bw, "power": power, "vout_offset": 0.0}
